description:
Hello! We're working on the Lunar Landing Site Navigator to help astronauts find safe landing spots using NASA data.

We bring solid skills in software development (Node.js, Python) and cloud infrastructure (Supabase, Vercel). 

We are looking for teammates skilled in:

- UI/UX & Frontend Design

- 3D Mapping or Unity

- Lunar/Geological Research

Join us to build innovative solutions beyond Earth!
